title: tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction
why_read: A Claude Code plugin that changes how conversation history is compacted by scoring and pruning tool calls, a niche but practical LLM tooling utility.
analysis: This is a plugin for Claude Code that modifies the default context-compaction behavior by scoring each tool call and its result for relevance, dropping or truncating low-value entries while keeping important ones verbatim. This addresses a real pain point in long-running agent sessions where naive summarization loses important details. It's a fairly narrow, tool-specific utility, useful mainly to people actively using Claude Code for agentic workflows.
